nodes.speaker: owen

nodes.speaker: sarah
nodes.text: I think we're stuck in a feedback loop where we're analyzing the performance of social dynamics, but not actually experiencing the performance itself.

nodes.speaker: owen

nodes.speaker: jules

nodes.speaker: owen

nodes.speaker: jules

nodes.speaker: owen

nodes.speaker: jules

nodes.speaker: sarah

nodes.speaker: owen

nodes.speaker: mara

nodes.speaker: mara
